title: Conversation Topic
description: A conversation topic entity, intended to back a lookup (reference) dataset. Each record represents a single topic in a topic taxonomy, keyed by the leaf topic, so that conversation data referencing the same topic can be joined to it to resolve the topic's hierarchy.

xdm:topic.title: Topic
xdm:topic.description: The specific topic. Serves as the primary identifier for the topic lookup and is the key that conversation data joins against.
